hero.promise: Mental health care that feels safe, human, and unhurried.
hero.sub: I'm Mical Pacheco, a board-certified psychiatric nurse practitioner offering thoughtful evaluation, medication management, and bilingual care across the lifespan.
hero.note: Free 15-minute introductory call · Most questions answered before your first visit.

about.title: Care should feel like being truly listened to.
about.paragraph1: Welcome. I am really glad you are here.
about.paragraph2: Looking for mental health care can feel overwhelming, and just being here is an important first step. My practice is grounded in compassion, respect, and genuine connection. I believe care should feel safe, supportive, and tailored to you as a whole person.
about.paragraph3: As a board certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner, I take time to listen and understand your story, your concerns, and your goals. Whether you are feeling anxious, overwhelmed, stuck, or simply seeking clarity and support, you do not have to navigate it alone.
about.paragraph4: It would be an honor to support you on your journey toward healing and balance.

how.title: A calm, clear path to your first appointment.
how.subtitle: No confusing intake mazes. Three simple steps from reaching out to ongoing support.
how.s1p: Book online or call for a free 15-minute introductory conversation — no pressure, just a chance to see if we're a good fit.
how.s2p: A thorough, unhurried psychiatric evaluation where we explore your history, goals, and a plan built around you.
how.s3p: Regular follow-ups for medication management and support — in person or via secure telehealth, on your schedule.

services.title: Comprehensive psychiatric care, across the lifespan.
services.subtitle: Evidence-based, trauma-informed services tailored to where you are right now.
services.evaluationsDesc: DSM-5-TR diagnostic assessments across the lifespan
services.medicationDesc: Initiation, titration, and monitoring of psychiatric medications
services.riskDesc: Suicide and violence risk assessments with safety planning
services.crisisDesc: Immediate support and intervention during mental health crises
services.bilingualDesc: Services available in English and Spanish
services.therapyDesc: CBT, Supportive Psychotherapy, Motivational Interviewing, Trauma-Informed Care, Psychoeducation
services.coordinationDesc: Collaboration with therapists and other healthcare providers

contact.title: Ready when you are.
contact.subtitle: Reach out with any questions, or book your first appointment. I'd be honored to support you.

crisis.title: In a crisis? Help is available right now.
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call 911. For free, confidential 24/7 support, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline). This website is not for medical emergencies.

book.title: It would be an honor to support you.
book.subtitle: Choose the option that feels easiest. New patients are welcome, and a free 15-minute call is the simplest place to begin.
book.note: Typical response within one business day.
